title: Never a Scratch (runtime selftest)
logline: Patch rings Rivet in the yard to lift the Valet's sedan and roll it to the gate, which is a fixture that proves the quest runtime, not a campaign quest.
goal: Exercise every runtime path once: payphone offer, go_to, steal, deliver, beat lines, one soul bark, one heat bark, heat clamp and the cash reward.
whyNotFiller: It is a test fixture, and its lines still obey the doctrine: Patch's fee joke, Rivet's clocked-out denial and the Valet's paint-and-I bit each land a laugh or a character note.

beats.title: Loading Bay 3
beats.summary: Patch's payphone rings; Rivet answers and walks to Loading Bay 3.

beats.title: Lift the sedan
beats.summary: Rivet gets into the Valet's sedan parked in the yard.

beats.title: Roll it to the gate
beats.summary: Rivet drives the sedan to the yard gate.

lines.speaker: patch
lines.text: Patch. You picked up on the ninth ring, a record for someone with no pulse. Loading Bay 3. Go.

lines.speaker: rivet
lines.text: I clocked out. I distinctly remember clocking out.

lines.speaker: patch
lines.text: Nobody clocks out, Rivet. The sedan in the yard belongs to a man who says never a scratch with his whole chest. Take it to the gate.

lines.speaker: the-valet
lines.text: Never a scratch. I will know. The paint and I have an understanding.

lines.speaker: rivet
lines.text: I weld for a living. I can promise him exactly one scratch, and it will be structural.

lines.speaker: patch
lines.text: Roll it to the gate. Five hundred waits in the coin return, and the Valet owes me a favour he doesn't know about yet.

lines.speaker: rivet
lines.text: Five hundred. I used to weld that in a shift. Now I steal it in a minute and feel worse.

lines.speaker: hauler
lines.text: Oh, a little car. Can I hug it? Gently. Then very much not gently.

lines.speaker: patch
lines.text: That's two sirens, Rivet. The fee is the same. My opinion of you is not.

mechanics.name: Payphone job start
mechanics.summary: Patch's payphone rings at the first beat's location; answering it starts the quest.

provenance.ownerNotes: Runtime selftest fixture for WP4 (quest-runtime); not a campaign quest.
